### To the Uttermost: How Jesus Keeps Us Day by Day
Author: Scott Hubbard
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/to-the-uttermost
Passage: Hebrews 7:25
Points:
- Jesus saves His people completely and forever because He continuously lives to pray for them.
- Christ's present priestly intercession ensures that believers' faith will not ultimately fail in trials.
- Because Jesus continually pleads the merit of His cross before the Father, Satan cannot condemn believers.
- Believers have permanent security because Christ advocates for them according to the Father's own gracious will.

### Before the Throne for You: What It Means for Christ to Intercede
Author: Chris Bruno
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/before-the-throne-for-you
Passage: Hebrews 7:25
Points:
- Christ's continuous heavenly intercession guarantees that He will save those united to Him completely and forever.
- His intercession is unique and unrepeatable because it rests solely on His own finished sacrifice and resurrection.
- Believers do not need any secondary human or saintly intermediaries to gain hearing and favor before God.
- Knowing that Jesus actively pleads on our behalf inspires deep boldness and confidence in prayer.

### An Unstained Priest
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/unstained-priest
Passage: Hebrews 7:26
Points:
- Levitical sacrifices could not bring perfection, functioning only as temporary signposts toward a greater priest.
- Jesus precisely answers humanity's spiritual need because He is holy, innocent, and unstained by evil.
- Christ shared our human nature without its corruption, remaining set apart from sinners in moral purity.
- Believers receive salvation because God counts Christ's untainted righteousness as their own through faith.

### Time with God - November 9, 2016
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/timewithgod/time-with-god-november-9-2016.html
Passage: Hebrews 7:25
Points:
- Under the old covenant, high priests offered animal sacrifices repeatedly to make atonement for sins.
- Jesus fulfills and surpasses this system by serving as both the High Priest and the sacrifice itself.
- Christ's ongoing intercession continually applies the virtue of His cross to the lives of His followers.
- Christian salvation is permanently secure because God will never overturn the sufficiency of Christ's sacrifice.
